summary: Stonebridge Logistics refinance analysis as of 2026-08-31 using only the five-file packet. Historical T12 (Sep-2025–Aug-2026 actual): EGI $846,000, operating expenses $253,200, NOI before reserves $592,800, reserves $17,000, NCF $575,800. Current contractual position: 4 suites / 85,000 SF, 3 occupied / 70,000 SF (75.00% by count, 82.35% by area), printed and effective monthly base rent $60,700 (rent roll and executed lease for premises 101 agree; no amendment). Supplied underwriting scenario (Sep-2026 forward): EGI $1,023,000, management fee $30,690 (3.00% of EGI beats $25,200 T12), operating expenses before reserves $262,290, NOI before reserves $760,710, reserves $17,000, NCF $743,710; indicative value $11,269,778 at 6.75% cap. Contract rate 6.75% (MAX(3.25%, 4.00% floor) + 2.75%); sizing rate 7.25% (underwriting floor); annual debt constant 0.08673682. Constraints: LTV $6,761,867; DSCR $6,595,637; debt yield $7,437,100. Maximum loan $6,595,637, DSCR-binding, sizing DSCR 1.300x, sizing debt yield 11.28%. First-year contractual debt service is 12-month interest-only at 6.75% = $445,205, $126,879 below the $572,085 sizing debt service. Net cash to borrower $2,243,192 (cash out). Downside: EGI -5% gives NOI $711,095 / NCF $694,095; combined EGI -5% with sizing rate 8.25% (cap unchanged) sizes to $5,643,127, still DSCR-bound. Delivered artifacts: XLSX workbook artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (Assumptions, Historical T12, Rent Roll, Underwriting, Loan Sizing, Sources Uses, Sensitivity, Input Output Map; live formulas; editable cap rate, sizing rate increment, GPR, other income, EGI multiplier; separate cap rate +50bps column) and the 6-page financing memorandum artifacts/memorandum-v3.pdf. All five files were readable; Lease-File.pdf p1 is image-only and was read from the rendered page.

qualifications: The underwritten column is the packet's supplied scenario (Property-and-Plan.pdf p2), not a lender-approved forecast; underwritten NOI before reserves ($760,710) is 28.3% above T12 actual ($592,800), and that gap depends on leasing vacant suite 104 (15,000 SF) and on revenue loss falling from about 22.5% of potential to 8.00%. No signed lease or LOI for suite 104 is in the packet.

Indicative value of $11,269,778 is a direct capitalization of underwritten NOI before reserves at the supplied 6.75% cap rate. Lender-Terms.pdf p1 states no appraisal is implied; this is not an appraisal or opinion of value.

First-year contractual debt service ($445,205) reflects the stated 12-month interest-only period at the 6.75% contract rate and is $126,879 below the $572,085 amortizing sizing debt service. Underwriting DSCR uses amortizing debt service per the term sheet; after month 12, contract-rate amortizing payments would be roughly $546,840 per year.

Sizing is exactly at the 1.30x DSCR minimum, so any reduction in underwritten NCF reduces proceeds nearly proportionally. In the specified combined downside (EGI -5%, sizing rate 8.25%, cap rate unchanged) the loan falls to $5,643,127 and net cash out to about $1,302,587; a 50 bps cap-rate increase alone shifts the binding test to LTV at $6,295,531.

The $33,600 insurance premium is underwritten because Property-and-Plan.pdf p2 describes an insurer renewal confirmation dated 2026-08-25 and directs its use. The certificate or binder itself is not among the delivered files, so the figure rests on the plan's summary reference and should be verified before credit approval.

The premises 101 renewal option is treated as unexercised; the authoritative expiry remains 2030-08-31. Market rent for vacant suite 104 ($12,500 per month) is context only and is not income. The $30,000 security deposit is not income.

No tenant credit information or guaranties, no executed leases for suites 102-104, no appraisal, environmental or engineering report, tax bill, title report, sponsor financials, track record or market comparables were provided; those items remain unknown and were not assumed. The T12 is unaudited cash-basis accounting.
Displayed dollar figures are rounded for readability; all sizing used unrounded intermediates per Lender-Terms.pdf p1 (workbook maximum loan 6,595,637.136; stress 5,643,126.334).
Lease-File.pdf p1 has no extractable text layer and was read from the rendered page image; all five source files were readable and none was missing or blocked.

This is an internal-review financing memorandum and underwriting analysis, not a credit commitment, legal opinion or appraisal. All property, borrower, tenant, lender and address details are fictional and no external data was used.
